meta.name: brief
meta.description: Clarify a new customer brief, desired outcome, constraints and evidence gaps. Use for kickoff or a first meeting; do not repeat discovery already supplied.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理客户初期简报,理清目标、约束与待补证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚拿到新客户简报,需要先厘清目标、约束和信息缺口再开工
copy.tagline_en: Turn a new customer brief into clear goals, constraints and open questions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're handed a new client brief and need to clarify goals before starting work

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先读任务上下文约定和方法,再围绕一份新客户简报做澄清:明确期望结果、约束条件和证据缺口。已有调研信息不会重复提问。
howto.when: 在新项目启动会或首次会议、手上有新客户简报时接管。若由 @fde 调用,则沿用其当前的脱敏信息包与范围,不重新开始。

say.text: 帮我澄清这个新客户简报:期望结果、约束条件、证据缺口
say.note: 先读上下文约定与方法,再逐项澄清

say.text: 这是启动会,别重复已做过的调研,只问还没确认的
say.note: 跳过已回答内容,只补未确认部分

say.text: @fde 已经在跑,沿用它的脱敏包和范围,不要重来
say.note: 复用现有信息包,不重启设置或调研

howto.what_en: After install, Claude clarifies a new customer brief: desired outcome, constraints and evidence gaps. It first reads the task context contract and the method, then works from the supplied permitted context. It does not repeat discovery already supplied.
howto.when_en: Use at kickoff or a first meeting, when a new customer brief arrives. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or discovery.

say_en.text: Clarify this new customer brief: outcome, constraints, evidence gaps
say_en.note: Reads the context contract and method first

say_en.text: This is the kickoff; skip prior discovery, only ask what's open
@fde is already running; reuse its packet and scope, don't restart
say_en.note: Reuses the existing packet, no re-setup
